messages.subject: Project Lyra – draft heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Alison, Adam,

Attached are the draft heads of terms reflecting the commercials discussed: a 5-year initial term, implementation fee of £185,000, annual subscription of £312,000, O&M of £96,000, and an 18% shared-savings fee. Clauses 9–11 (60-day exclusivity, confidentiality and costs) are intended to be binding.

Grateful for sign-off so we can move to the MSSA.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
